requestBody.query: How to use the Interlogix SimonXT panel Smart Home

200.answer:
Here is a summary about the Interlogix SimonXT panel:

- You can open and close a door or window without setting off the alarm by using the bypass button.
- To cancel a bypass, simply disarm the panel.
- To bypass a sensor, press the bypass button, enter your master code, find the sensor you wish to bypass and press OK.

snippets.text: You will be able to open and close the door or window as many times as you want without setting off the alarm. To cancel a bypass, simply disarm the panel. Direct method: If your system is already armed and the entry delay has finished, follow the steps below to bypass a sensor. Press the Bypass button.

snippets.text: The system will scan for networks available to your panel and list them. If you 're already connected to Wi-Fi, you can connect to a different network. Select the network and enter the Wi-Fi password, then touch CONNECT. Using the web portal Log in to the Bell Smart Home web portal. Click on Settings in the left panel. Click on Control Panel Settings. The system will scan for networks available to your panel and list them. If you're already connected to Wi-Fi, you can connect to a different network. Select the network and enter the Wi-Fi password, then touch CONNECT. Using the control panel Swipe down on the screen of your panel to access the menu. Picture1a Select Settings. Picture2a Select Advanced Settings Picture3a Enter your master user code. Picture4a Select Wi-Fi. Picture5a Select your home network, enter your Wi-Fi password and press connect.

snippets.text: Touch the menu image003_menubold . Touch Users. Touch the + sign. Enter the user's first and last name and then touch Create. In Access Code, enter the user's desired code. In Device Access, touch to select either: Full Access to allow access to all devices on the system.
